mapper.sql: select b.batch_id, b.batch_no, b.buyer_id, b.station_id, b.gas_type, b.purchase_date, b.qty, b.unit_price, b.amount, b.pay_status, b.invoice_status, b.invoice_no, b.invoiced_at, b.version, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, s.station_code, s.station_name, bu.buyer_name, (select ifnull(sum(r.qty), 0) from gas_purchase_receipt r where r.batch_id = b.batch_id) as received_qty, (select ifnull(sum(p.amount), 0) from gas_purchase_payment p where p.batch_id = b.batch_id) as paid_amount from gas_purchase_batch b left join gas_station s on b.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_buyer bu on b.buyer_id = bu.buyer_id
mapper.select: select batch_id, batch_no, buyer_id, station_id, gas_type, purchase_date, qty, unit_price, amount, pay_status, invoice_status, invoice_no, invoiced_at, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from gas_purchase_batch where batch_id = #{batchId} for update
select batch_id, batch_no from gas_purchase_batch where batch_no = #{batchNo} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into gas_purchase_batch( batch_no, buyer_id, station_id, gas_type, purchase_date, qty, unit_price, amount, pay_status, invoice_status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{batchNo}, #{buyerId}, #{stationId}, #{gasType}, #{purchaseDate}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, 'UNPAID', 'UNINVOICED', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update gas_purchase_batch set invoice_status = #{invoiceStatus}, invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}, invoiced_at = if(#{invoiceStatus} = 'INVOICED', sysdate(), null), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId}
